title: BLEACH Brave Souls
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#342, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.8, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after a short session into the game. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on D3DMetal (free to play). After the logo the intro video stays black while its audio plays; it can be skipped after a few seconds, and the game does not play it again after the first start. It is a port of the mobile game, so some dialogs need the mouse even though a controller works in play.

knownIssues.symptom: The intro video after the logo is black while its audio plays
knownIssues.cause: Not diagnosed. A game video played through Windows Media Foundation is the usual cause of picture-less video under Wine
knownIssues.fix: Skip it after a few seconds. It only plays on the first start (highball-db#342)

knownIssues.cause: The game is a mobile port that expects a touch, which the mouse stands in for
knownIssues.fix: Click those dialogs with the mouse
